messages:
anya: Quick usability note — new signups get stuck on the empty "Starter projects" area. The CTA is a tiny link that reads 'Add sample' and users think it's optional.

mike: Yep, same pattern. Small link = low priority in users' eyes. We should surface a clear primary action.

sophia: Suggest changing to a primary button labeled 'Import a starter project' + a small caption 'Includes prompts, demo endpoint, and README'. Also show 2 small preview thumbnails.

devon: A11y: button must be first tabbable element in the area, include aria-describedby for the caption, thumbnails need alt text. Preview modal should be role=dialog with focus trap.

anya: Also propose microcopy variant: use "Starter project" instead of "sample" to reduce jargon. Add a tertiary 'Start from scratch' link for experienced users.

mike: We should A/B test two variants: thumbnails vs single illustration + bullets. Track click-through and time-to-first-model-call.

devon: Action items: anya -> mocks, mike -> metrics plan, sophia -> a11y test cases. I'll file a ticket.

onboarding-bot: Task created: PRO-4001 "Starter empty-state: CTA clarity + accessibility" assigned to anya/mike/sophia. Due 2026-04-10.
